artifacts.summary: 2-phase, 0.25h plan correcting the four dead .claude/extensions/nvim/context/... standards pointers in root CLAUDE.md to the flat .claude/context/project/neovim/standards/ form, plus a repo-wide confirming grep.

memory_candidates.content: Before applying .claude/rules/source-store-deploy-boundary.md, confirm the target really is a deploy artifact rather than assuming it from the path. The decisive check is three cheap probes: (1) git check-ignore the target -- a deployed artifact is gitignored, a hand-maintained one is tracked; (2) look for a source-store counterpart (for a CLAUDE.md, agent-system/extensions/*/merge-sources/claudemd.md, which feed the GENERATED .claude/CLAUDE.md, not the repo-root CLAUDE.md); (3) check .claude-extensions.json installed_files for the target path. In this repo root CLAUDE.md (Neovim Configuration Guidelines) is tracked, has no merge-source, and appears in no installed_files list -- it is hand-maintained and the correct durable edit target, unlike the auto-generated .claude/CLAUDE.md.
